type_en: men's ring with engraved dark stone (detail view only)
visual_en: Single close-up of a dark grey/black engraved stone with three nastaliq lines separated by ruled lines, seen deep inside a gold-tone collar; looks like a view of the stone's reverse/underside through the hoop.
notes_en: 249/250 are pixel-identical (DSC_2304, d=0). Only a detail shot; no full view of the ring in my range. The file was renamed DSC_2304 so it sorts right after DSC_2303 (#208) and the ring #203-208 in g1's range (round grey-green engraved stone, gold-tone fluted mount), so it probably shows that ring (perhaps a second inscription on the stone's back). The inscription does not match the face of #204, so this is a guess: lead please compare with g1's #203-208 piece and merge if agreed.

type_en: men's ring with engraved rectangular carnelian

notes_en: 252 front, 254 the same ring a little further away (crack visible in both).

type_en: men's ring with engraved oval carnelian, two-tone

notes_en: Single view. Looks like g1's #196/198 (gold rim on a silver ring), but there the stone is set lengthwise, so I judge them different rings.

type_en: men's ring with engraved oval carnelian

notes_en: Single photo (edited file DSC_3766_edit, no frame number).

type_en: men's ring with engraved oval carnelian

notes_en: Single photo. Compared with g1's #239/242 (similar petal bezel): the inscription is different.

type_en: men's ring with engraved oval carnelian

type_en: men's ring with engraved oval carnelian

type_en: men's ring with engraved oval carnelian, foliate shoulders
visual_en: Oval red carnelian engraved in nastaliq on a dotted floral ground, with a dated band at the bottom; engraved yellow-gold bezel collar and rose-gold leaf-shaped shoulders.
facts_en: date band at the bottom, «١٢٤١»(?) (#263)
notes_en: RE-SHOOT ACROSS RANGES: the same ring as g1's #102-107 (DSC_1955/1971/1984/1992, S04, 2021-05-07). Same layout (long stroke at the top, two big bowls, date band), the same small dark speck at the lower left, and the same rose-gold leaf mount. Lead: merge with that g1 piece.

type_en: men's ring with engraved round carnelian
visual_en: Round orange carnelian engraved with an interlaced (knotted) thuluth composition, with dark red inclusion flecks at the top and bottom edge; gold-tone mount with scalloped claw bezel and fluted shank with beaded edge.
notes_en: 264 front, 265 side (10 min later, same knotted layout and flecks).

type_en: men's ring with engraved talismanic carnelian (grid of divine names)
visual_en: Large oval dark-red carnelian engraved with a talismanic grid (jadwal) of small cells holding «يا ...» invocations, inside a border inscription; gold-tone mount with scalloped claws and fluted shank with beaded edge.
facts_en: grid cells of «يا ...» invocations / divine names (#267)
notes_en: 267 front, 268 and 269 side views (the grid of text is visible in 269).

type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian «الله»

facts_en: central word «الله» (#270)
notes_en: 270 front, 271 and 272 side views. Not the same as the silver-tone S13 ring #643/644.

type_en: men's ring with engraved pale honey agate
visual_en: Round pale honey/beige agate (looks like chalcedony) engraved in thuluth with one long horizontal stroke and a small cross mark; gold-tone mount with scalloped claws and fluted shank.
notes_en: 273 and 274 front (different lighting), 276 side, 2 min after 274.

type_en: men's ring with engraved pear-shaped agate

notes_en: 277 and 278 front, 279 and 280 side views.

type_en: men's ring with engraved yellow agate (JWL-0054)
visual_en: Rectangular yellow agate set across the shank, engraved with «بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم» in a woven grid of elongated letters; silver-tone mount with beaded frame and knurled pyramid-pattern shoulders.

notes_en: Loose files JWL-0054-1/-2. Almost the same design as JWL-0055 (#285/286), but the stone and composition differ (here landscape, there portrait), so they are two rings.

type_en: men's ring with engraved yellow agate (JWL-0055)

notes_en: Loose files JWL-0055-1/-2; 286 is the inside of the same knurled shank. A twin design to JWL-0054 (#283/284) with a different stone.

type_en: men's ring with engraved round green stone

facts_en: hallmarks: oval maker's mark (unread) + F (#299)
notes_en: 290 front; 292, 294 and 297 other angles; 299 is the hallmark on the inner shank, shot 2 min later, before the next ring.

type_en: men's ring with engraved rectangular carnelian, star-medallion mount

notes_en: 301 front, 302 and 304 sides, 306 hallmark (the pierced openwork shows behind it). The same mount style as #318-326 (S10) and similar to S12 #498-501, but the stones differ, so they are different rings.

type_en: men's ring with engraved oval carnelian

type_en: pendant with engraved honey agate

notes_en: RE-SHOOT MERGE: 311 (kj (9), S07 19:34) and 313/315 (kj (10)/(11), S08 20:09) show the same pendant. Folder K&A.

type_en: gold coin pendant (early Islamic dinar)
visual_en: Gold coin with Kufic legends, in the style of an Umayyad/Abbasid dinar, mounted as a pendant in a gold-tone faceted frame with bail; the photo shows both faces.
facts_en: obverse «لا اله الا الله وحده لا شريك له», reverse «محمد رسول الله» (#317)
notes_en: Loose file «36». I count it as one pendant shown front and back in one composite image. Whether the coin is genuine cannot be judged from the photo. Possibly related to the coin pendants at #878 (S18) or #766-770 (S15); lead may check.

type_en: men's ring with engraved carnelian (Basmala & Shahada), star-medallion mount

facts_en: intaglio scene: eagle on pedestal + standing man with sword (#369); hallmarks inside shank: oval «جدي» + letter F + oval «تهران» (#371)
notes_en: 369 (JWL-0056-1) and 370 (JWL-0057-1) clearly show the same intaglio (370 is a rotated side view), and 371 (JWL-0057-2) is the hallmark inside the fluted shank. The file names suggest two codes (JWL-0056 and JWL-0057), but I see one ring. Flagged for the lead because of the naming.

type_en: ring with round turquoise in crown mount

type_en: engraved stone centrepiece with two side loops
visual_en: Oval cream/beige stone (looks like cream agate; could be bone/ivory-like material) with a large central thuluth verse and a border inscription; several cracks, fixed with two domed gold rivets through the face; thin gold-tone bezel with a loop on each side, used as a necklace/bracelet centrepiece.
facts_en: «ويسبح الرعد بحمده والملائكة من خيفته» (Q 13:13) (#393)
notes_en: 393 front, 395 angled. Folder K&A.

type_en: thin band ring with engraved oval carnelian
visual_en: Oval carnelian engraved in two nastaliq lines divided by a long stroke; thin plain silver-tone wire band and simple bezel.
facts_en: top line «الله محمد علي», lower line «...حسن...»(?) (#401)
notes_en: 401 and 400 are two edits of the same frame (d=57, kept both); 398 and 399 are their pixel duplicates. 397 is backlit so the stone looks amber, but the layout matches 401 (top line ending «علي», divider stroke, two big bowls, upright strokes at both ends). 403 is the same thin band with the stone out of focus. All 3 frames fall within 5 min in the R folder; I'm fairly but not fully sure they are one ring.

type_en: ring with spiderweb turquoise
